diagram_math_checks.objects: Simple generators s1,s2,s3 and their simple roots; P12=span(e_s1,e_s2), P23=span(e_s2,e_s3).
diagram_math_checks.check: Chain arrows encode the sign of a bilinear form on an ordered pair, not morphisms. There are three vertices and precisely two arrows s1 to s2 and s2 to s3; no s1-s3 edge.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Supplier def-cg-coxeter-oriented-euler-form-and-c-sorting-word Definition (2) sets omega=E-E^T with lower triangular Euler convention; local F6/F7 and proof 1.2/2.2 give omega12=omega23=1 and omega13=0.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Each adjacent simple-root plane and its three positive roots.
diagram_math_checks.check: Rays occur counterclockwise as e_si, e_si+e_s(i+1), e_s(i+1). Drawn coordinates (2,0),(1,1.732),(-1,1.732) depict angles 0,60,120 degrees to plotting precision, with a common scale. There are exactly three rays per panel and no crossings except their common origin.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Local proof 2.1 explicitly identifies the positive-root lists; F7 gives B(e_i,e_i)=1 and B(e_i,e_(i+1))=-1/2. Thus B(e_i+e_(i+1),e_i+e_(i+1))=1 and the sum lies between the two simple roots at their bisector.
